question: On the same archived validation parents, what signed axial correlation remains in the original four-label learned posterior after subtracting its frozen one-site additive prediction? How tight is the bound at six sites and across the measured range?
status: Follow-through motivated by an already examined sparse result. Not a new encoder, independent replication, motif validation, change to the locked prediction, or test-set analysis.
fold: Only native validation, in l20_pairs.partition order. Stream only selected species rows, verify endpoint and ordered lineage against original sectors receipt. No access to index 6, test configurations or screened labels. No simulation, dynamics, refitting, or model selection.
field: The four real-valued coordinates of the fixed laboratory-identity posterior minus the archived sectors.Fields cold-train additive output (55 coefficients per label on original ternary coding including intercept). No orientation averaging, hard labels, rescaling, temperature re-centering, or new templates. Trace = sum of the four within-label autocovariances, not the covariance of their sum.
measurement: For every parent and all 8000 periodic centers compute all four fields and the A indicator; circular cross-correlate by FFT along the three positive coordinate axes, then average axes equally. Contact r=0 is separate. Signed center separations 3..9 inclusive correspond to empty-site gap r-3. No wrapped half-box lag; no staggering, absolute-value transform, correlation-length fit, or infinite-volume extrapolation.
connected: Split consecutive validation parents into 256 disjoint packets of eight. Within each packet subtract the mean of m_i*m_j over all ordered i!=j, where m is each parent's spatial mean, from mean raw within-parent spatial products. This estimates the ensemble mean squared without using self pairs, under archive translation invariance and independent parent sampling. Do not subtract each parent's own mean. Report zero-mode S(0)=8000*Var(m) using unbiased packet variance; physical field fluctuations are retained. A and B counts must each be fixed across all parents in a temperature; additionally verify A contact equals its Bernoulli variance.
controls: Within each packet cyclically mismatch the second field to the next distinct parent at the same lag/origin and subtract the same cross-parent baseline. Report signed A-occupancy and mismatched covariances including r6. For the first three parents per index validate all examined FFT lags/directions against literal periodic rolls for same and mismatched fields. Also check the vectorized identity field against the original nonlinear and additive formulas on explicit wrapped blocks including box boundaries. Arithmetic controls must pass; statistical controls are reported, not tuned away.
inference: No staged stopping. Equally weighted disjoint packets, Student-t intervals on packet mean estimators (df=255); individual sites, axes and lags are not replicates. Report pointwise 95% and Bonferroni simultaneous 95% bounds: all 3 temperatures x 7 disjoint lags x 5 residual readouts (4 labels + trace); A separate 21-cell control family, mismatched separate 126-cell family. Contact and zero mode separate pointwise diagnostics. Pointwise cold r=6 trace is the focal precision comparison, not an additional independent discovery. Equivalence means strict interval containment in (-0.001,+0.001) signed probability squared; a zero crossing is not equivalence. Report both pointwise and family classifications.
benchmark: Compare r=6 residual trace to the original sparse sectors final 6-look-adjusted t interval at each beta, including width ratio and containment/overlap at matching coverage (new 0.05/6 as well as pointwise). These are the same parents: overlap is descriptive, not an independent confirmation or test of a difference. No claim about dynamics, other operators, other distances, other directions, larger boxes or asymptotic order.
